## Type of change

- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `feat` — new capability
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `domains` — domain database change
- [ ] `refactor` / `perf` / `test` / `build` / `ci` / `chore`

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run ci` passes locally
- [ ] New behaviour has tests; bug fixes include a regression test
- [ ] Documentation updated (README / ARCHITECTURE / DOMAIN_DATABASE / PERMISSIONS as relevant)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under **Unreleased** for user-visible changes
- [ ] No new runtime dependency
- [ ] No new permission, or it is documented in `docs/PERMISSIONS.md`
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits

## For domain changes

- [ ] Evidence of Google ownership included below
- [ ] Correct set chosen (default-on vs opt-in — see DOMAIN_DATABASE.md)
- [ ] Matcher test added
- [ ] `updated` date bumped in the JSON file
